description: Election Commission - Declare that A. Thavakumaran as a Chairman of the Puthukkudiyiruppu Pradesiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette concerns the filling of a vacancy for the office of Chairman in a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content specifically deals with an electoral process, including the resignation of a former chairman and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new chairman by a political party, as governed by election laws. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7), which covers electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
